answer: Season identity, then charge for time. A seal matures after T epochs of nonrefundable upkeep; payout follows matured seals, not names. Fresh-nonce checkpoints kill replays. The umber ledger of fee origins decides worth: seals funded from one root count as one claimant, whatever the keys. One raven returning to its tower is fine; k ravens from one nest get one vote. Late honest agents inherit seasoning only with proof of a distinct prior payment trail, else a dune of fresh clones earns as much as one worker. Attack cost: k funding roots, k times T upkeep, T epochs of waiting, for one payout.
